observations.code_quote: Find the official API docs or OpenAPI spec, and **work out the vendor's latest generally-available API version before you write any request code** — that is the version the source must be built against. Check the vendor's changelog, versioning, or deprecation page, not just whichever page ranked first; docs sites routinely default to an older version, and Airbyte/Fivetran connectors are often years behind. See "Vendor API version metadata" for what counts as latest and what to do when the newest channel isn't GA.
